SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(c-1) AS extra FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (SELECT web_order_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_line', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (SELECT return_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_no_dispatch_status', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND (o.web_order_id IS NULL OR o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_zztest', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id = 900
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT 'zz_test_sales' AS item, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.net_amount) AS amt
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-20' AND DATE '2025-12-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'zz_test_returns', COUNT(*), SUM(r.refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
